examples.quote: Restricting early reproductive opportunities led many individual parents to reproduce later. A complete block before age 50 removed all births in that age band, while total births fell much less. This demonstrates a compensating response to this intervention in these simulated worlds. It does not establish that naturally varying age-specific reproduction causes the earlier food-dependent population pattern.
